text: Teaching Objectives This program offers you an unique opportunity not only to learn but to experience the dynamic cultural and economic context of China and its relationship with the rest of the world. Students will gain an advanced understanding of China’s economic and business environment，acquire the linguistic and intercultural skills necessary to operate effectively in China，and obtain real working experience through internship opportunities. Core Courses International Business Microeconomic Theory Macroeconomic Theory Social Science Research Methods Chinese Culture Studies Marketing in China China Business Laws China Business Environment China Foreign Relations China and International Organizations Elementary Chinese Business Chinese Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Chinese Business and International Relations by Beijing Foreign Studies University
